{{Otheruses|Swap Meet}}
'''Swap Meets''' were [[Standard month/Legends|monthly]] open markets held at [[The Puddle]]. [[Merchant/Legends|Merchants]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and [[black marketeer]]s sold their wares and the market served as the settlement's primary source of income. Dozens of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] regularly attended, and illegal weapons and items were also available for purchase.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
